assumptions.species_assumed: quarter-sawn white oak; verify every board and do not mix species within a laminated member
assumptions.moisture_gate: 6-9% after acclimation; layers within one percentage point inside each laminated member
assumptions.end_trim_reserve_rule: The operation-specific end reserve is a planning value. Preserve every long board until defects and clear squared ends are mapped; the actual loss controls.
assumptions.stile_lane_width_gate: STOCK-I and STOCK-K must each dress to at least 8-7/8 inches of clear jointed width: two 4-3/8-inch continuous lanes plus one 1/8-inch width-rip kerf
assumptions.grain_rule: Every core, face lamella, and stave runs continuously parallel with the completed member; no cross-grain layer, butt joint, scarf joint, or hidden short block is permitted in a structural door member.
assumptions.no_resaw_rule: No resaw operation is permitted; each face lamella remains a single whole-thickness piece while it is flattened and planed to 5/16 inch.
assumptions.milling_rule: No reported face or edge is a datum. Rough dimensions do not prove dressed yield; cup, bow, twist, edge cleanup, width-rip kerf, and rest movement consume stock. Every 5/16-inch face is made by staged planing from one whole-thickness board or billet; no board is divided through its thickness.
assumptions.face_planing_rule: Flatten one reference face, rest, correct only as required, then plane the opposite face in shallow staged passes. Below stable machine thickness use a verified flat carrier with stops that cannot enter the cutter path. Rest again before final 5/16-inch calibration.
assumptions.lamination_rule: Prepare 7/8-inch cores and 5/16-inch face sheets separately, laminate both faces simultaneously against a flat platen with rigid cauls, cure and rest, then remove 1/16 inch from each outside face in alternating staged passes to reach 1/4 + 7/8 + 1/4 before any groove, Domino, hinge, or lock machining.
assumptions.label_rule: STOCK-A through STOCK-O are lumber inventory labels; D-101A through D-101N are finished door part identifiers; -CORE, -SF, and -BF identify laminated subparts.
assumptions.scope_rule: STOCK-A through STOCK-O are reserved exclusively for the door, its same-layup coupons, setup pieces, and future repair stock. No A-O material is credited to casing, backband, stop, cap, or plinth.
assumptions.zero_spare_release_rule: STOCK-M provides a dedicated panel and face-stock reserve, while finished-white-oak STOCK-N/O add uncut short-member reserve, but none relax the structural gates. Complete CHK-RS-01 on all A-O, verify STOCK-A's current 72-3/4-inch usable length, STOCK-M's reported finished 3/4 x 8-1/4 x 99 envelope, and N/O moisture, grain, flatness, defects, and clear yield, then prove CHK-ST-01 on B/C plus CHK-ST-02 on I/K before releasing M/D/G/H panel crosscuts or E/F/J/L short-member production cuts.
assumptions.staged_milling_rule: Flatten one face, rest and recheck, plane the opposite face parallel, joint one edge, record actual dressed thickness/width/clear length, and stop at the controlled rough size until the next gate passes. Do not process every board to final size and measure only afterward.
assumptions.machine_minimum_rule: Never surface a billet shorter or thinner than the machine manufacturer's safe minimum. Keep a longer mother piece or use a verified carrier/sled and guarded procedure when required.

critical_checks.check: Acclimate and map A-O at full usable length. For A, confirm the current 72-3/4-inch length and inspect the new end after the 6-inch damage removal. For M, verify the reported finished 3/4 x 8-1/4 x 99-inch envelope. For N/O, record moisture, grain, flatness, defects, and clear squared-end yield while preserving their confirmed finished-white-oak 1-3/4 x 11 x 74-inch envelopes. For every board record actual dimensions, straightness, moisture, grain, bow, cup, twist, checks, knots, pith, runout, and clear squared-end limits.
critical_checks.pass: Every proposed billet has a traceable clear envelope; A has a sound squared end and at least 72-3/4 inches of usable mapped reserve length; M has at least 5/8-inch recoverable thickness throughout three 16-1/16-inch panel billets and sufficient clear width for the signed three-stave map; N/O are positively identified and remain full at 74 inches unless a signed fallback map is released; and every lamination family is the same species at 6-9% moisture with layers within one percentage point.
critical_checks.fallback: Reallocate only within A-O under a signed map. If M fails, remap D-101H to clear STOCK-A before purchasing panel stock. Use finished-white-oak N/O only for a documented short-member fallback; do not crosscut a long critical board to solve a short-part shortage.

critical_checks.check: Prove the whole-thickness staged plane/rest/carrier method on representative coupons, then prove STOCK-B and STOCK-C at full length.
critical_checks.pass: B yields the D-101A show face and C yields the D-101B show face, each continuous and glue-ready at 5/16 x 4-3/8 x 81-1/8 with no taper, end joint, defect, or unstable grain.
critical_checks.fallback: Stop and obtain replacement continuous face stock. Do not shorten, end-splice, or veneer over a failed stile face.

critical_checks.check: Prove the two full-length stile lanes in STOCK-I and STOCK-K before making the single width rip.
critical_checks.pass: Each board has at least 8-7/8 inches of clear jointed width for two 4-3/8-inch lanes plus the 1/8-inch kerf; each yields one straight 7/8 x 4-3/8 x 81 core and one continuous 5/16 x 4-3/8 x 81-1/8 back face after staged planing and rest. K retains the hinge and screw zones; I retains the lock envelope.
critical_checks.fallback: Stop and purchase only a replacement long layer for the failed stile. Reducing the 4-1/4-inch finished stile or joining any long layer end-to-end is not authorized.

critical_checks.check: Create and sign the revised CM-05 before cutting J or L. Because L is now 6 inches wide, J carries C, M, the 6-1/2-inch F stave, and G; L carries E, both D staves, and the 5-3/4-inch F stave.
critical_checks.pass: J yields three 16-1/4-inch core mother billets for C, M, and the 6-1/2-inch F stave plus one 12-inch G billet; J must retain at least one clear 6-1/2-inch jointed width envelope. L yields four 16-1/4-inch billets for E, the 5-inch and 2-1/4-inch D staves, and the 5-3/4-inch F stave from its current 6-inch width. Every core is 7/8 inch, clear, continuous in length, and traceable; usable width offcuts are retained for FP-05, whose source pool also requires at least five clear 16-1/4-inch mother billets combined from E/F.
critical_checks.fallback: Rearrange only clear J/L envelopes under a revised signed map. If the core map fails, prefer a clear finished-white-oak STOCK-N or STOCK-O short-core remap; if that also fails, purchase only the failed core stock. Never consume a critical stile layer.

critical_checks.check: Complete and sign FP-05 using up to two clear 16-1/4-inch STOCK-M tail billets after D-101H passes, plus D/H tails, eligible C/J/L longitudinal offcuts, and the required remaining clear mother billets from knot-mapped E/F. Keep STOCK-A intact unless a signed substitution is required.
critical_checks.pass: The map assigns both 5/16-inch faces for C/M/D/E/F/G at full rough width and length, keeps C/M/E/G one piece across width, places D seams at 4-3/8 show and 4-7/8 back, places F show seams at 3, 6-1/2, and 9-1/2 and back seams at 2-1/2, 5, and 9, contains no end joints, and identifies coupons and repair reserve.
critical_checks.fallback: Reassign clear pool strips without moving a released seam. Keep N/O out of the face pool unless a signed remap accepts the excessive thickness-planing loss. If the complete A-O pool still fails, purchase only the missing face billet; do not alter a stile layer or core allocation.

critical_checks.check: Only after CHK-RS-01, CHK-ST-01, and CHK-ST-02 pass, verify thickness and warp throughout every mapped M/G/H/D clear envelope. M must show three clear 16-1/16-inch shop billets within its reported finished 99-inch length and at least 5/8-inch recoverable thickness throughout. Then rough-crosscut only the RL-02 finished-length-plus-1-inch panel billets and mill-test each shorter billet.
critical_checks.pass: Each RL-02 billet yields its LS-05 controlled rough length after flattening and squaring; every stave remains at least 5/8 thick; M/H three-stave glue-ups and G's four-stave glue-up retain at least 16-3/8 aggregate jointed width, and both D pairs retain 7-3/8; all visible, tongue, and glue zones are clear.
critical_checks.fallback: If M fails, remap D-101H to clear STOCK-A. Use clear E/F or uncommitted J/L only after the structural short-member map passes; otherwise purchase replacement panel stock.

critical_checks.check: Press and destructively inspect same-layup coupons before every structural member family; coupon face stock must use the same whole-thickness staged plane/rest/carrier preparation as its production family.
critical_checks.pass: The 5/16 + 7/8 + 5/16 layup measures 1-1/2 before surfacing, cures without voids or slip, then finishes 1/4 + 7/8 + 1/4 at 1-3/8. Sectioned groove and DF samples retain at least 0.200 actual core wood to each face glue line and fail in wood rather than at the adhesive line.
critical_checks.fallback: Correct moisture, surface preparation, adhesive spread, pressure, platen, or cauls and remake the coupon. Production members remain on hold.

critical_checks.check: Transfer and verify the D-101D and D-101F three-plane seam maps after final width but before Domino machining.
critical_checks.pass: D core/show/back seams are 2-1/4, 4-3/8, and 4-7/8 from top. F core seam is 5-3/4; show seams are 3, 6-1/2, and 9-1/2; back seams are 2-1/2, 5, and 9. Each is within +/-1/32, every face seam is offset at least 1/2 from the nearest core seam, and calculated clearance to the retained medium-width mortise planforms is at least 0.3041 inch for D and 0.4291 inch for F, exceeding the 1/4-inch requirement.
critical_checks.fallback: Rebuild the affected sheet or core. Do not move a Domino center without revising the specification, register, story stick, templates, drawings, and lock gate.

typo_review.assessment: Each board is confirmed finished white oak at 1-3/4 x 11 x 74 inches and equals 9.90 board feet. At 74 inches neither board can replace an 81-inch continuous stile layer.
typo_review.action: Keep both boards full. Under CHK-RS-01 record moisture, grain, flatness, defects, and clear yield. Prefer them only as signed short-member core reserve.

typo_review.assessment: A's original 78-3/4-inch length is obsolete; six inches are charged to damage removal. M is newly reported as finished white oak and now carries D-101H plus up to two conditional face-pool billets.
typo_review.action: Keep A intact as reserve. Verify M's actual finished dimensions, straightness, moisture, grain, and clear envelope; cut three 16-1/16-inch M panel billets only after CHK-RS-01/CHK-ST-01/CHK-ST-02 pass.

typo_review.assessment: The original 7-inch width is obsolete. The current 6-inch edge-cleaned width cannot yield the planned 6-1/2-inch F core stave.
typo_review.action: Keep L full length. Under revised CM-05, move the 6-1/2-inch F stave to J and move J's 5-inch D stave to L. J must prove one clear 6-1/2-inch width envelope before either board is cut.

typo_review.assessment: Not a typo. It conditionally yields two continuous 4-3/8-inch lanes plus one 1/8-inch kerf only if the clear jointed width is at least 8-7/8 inches.
typo_review.action: Preserve full length and release I-01 only after CHK-ST-02.

typo_review.assessment: K simplifies to 1-3/8 and J/L equal 1-5/16. K conditionally supplies one stile core and one parallel stile back face; J/L supply the signed short-core map. Raw thickness does not prove flat dressed yield.
typo_review.action: Use only under the balanced LS-05 layer schedule and its staged whole-thickness planing controls.

fallback.conservative_door_plan: The baseline purchase quantity for the door is zero. Preserve every long board until the full dressed map, carrier-planing trials, signed core/face maps, and lamination coupons pass.
fallback.if_stile_face_fails: Purchase one continuous long face board of adequate thickness and width; never end-splice a stile face.
fallback.if_stile_core_fails: Purchase one clear long core board for the failed stile; never butt-, Domino-, or casually scarf-joint a stile core.
fallback.if_short_member_plan_fails: Revise CM-05 first using clear finished-white-oak STOCK-N/O as short-member core reserve; revise FP-05 using clear uncommitted A-O reserve only where planing loss is justified; then purchase only the failed short-member layer if the signed map still cannot close.
fallback.if_panel_plan_fails: Remap D-101H from M to clear STOCK-A first; use other door-only clear reserve only after the structural map is protected, then purchase replacement 4/4 panel stock.
fallback.moulding: Use only the separate S4S 4/4 and 6/4 purchase. Do not transfer A-O remnants to moulding until the completed door, retained coupons, and repair reserve are released.
